def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if g[y][x]==1]
    ys=[p[0] for p in pts];xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0=min(ys)-1;r1=max(ys)+1;c0=min(xs)-1;c1=max(xs)+1
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    def inside(y,x): return r0<=y<=r1 and c0<=x<=c1
    def frame(y,x): return inside(y,x) and (y==r0 or y==r1 or x==c0 or x==c1)
